candidates.title: Verify historical deliverables for the six admitted contract pairs
candidates.rationale: Actual event timestamps now resolve quote age, but exact historical contract deliverables remain the outstanding prerequisite for interpreting the assumed 100-share cash flows.
candidates.falsification: For each frozen pair, compare dated official contract and corporate-action records with the exact option identity and assumed deliverable. Any conflict or missing historical record leaves that case unverified; no replacement strike is allowed.
candidates.decision_impact: Determine which existing diagnostics can support contract-level economic interpretation and which must remain unavailable for an executable inference. This changes evidence quality, not selection thresholds.

candidates.title: Compare next-session financing with one frozen bullish HIRO confirmation
candidates.rationale: The current second-leg rule contains no new flow confirmation, and most completed purchases underperform covering the short at that minute. A separate test can isolate whether a fresh bullish flow/price reversal improves the second decision.
candidates.falsification: On newly collected complete next-session All Trades histories, freeze one fifteen-minute bullish call-flow/price confirmation and next-minute action before outcomes. Keep D1, the original nearer strike, financing and quote gates, D4 exit and costs unchanged. Reject the claim if its paired increment over financing-only and same-minute cover is not positive under the existing support criteria; no trigger remains a known no-purchase and missing flow remains censored.
candidates.decision_impact: Decide whether a later confirmation earns a place in the purchase policy. Requires future adequate HIRO data and a separate pre-outcome freeze; it cannot relabel the present five-date results.
